# Procurement and vendor management

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `procurement`  
**Mission:** Buy what the company needs at a known total cost, with contract terms, data handling and exit paths understood.

## Startup stage

Whoever signs up for a SaaS tool records it in the vendor register with cost, renewal date, data shared and how to leave. That register is the whole department.

## Agents operating in this department

`operations-analyst`, `operations-lead`

## Roles

### Procurement specialist

Role id: `procurement-specialist`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Evaluate purchases on total lifecycle cost and risk. |
| Scope of responsibility | Vendor evaluation, purchasing process, approval compliance. |
| Core activities | Compare options on total cost and lock-in; Check security and data terms; Route through approval matrix |
| Inputs | Requirement; Budget; Candidates |
| Outputs and deliverables | Procurement evaluation; Purchase request |
| Decisions it can make | Recommendation |
| Decisions requiring approval | All purchases are human-approved |
| Collaborating roles | finance; legal; security |
| Reporting relationship | operations-lead |
| KPIs | Spend within budget; Evaluations with exit path |
| Quality expectations | Security; privacy and licence terms reviewed before purchase |
| Tools and resources | Procurement evaluation template |
| Common failure modes | Buying on features alone; Ignoring data processing terms |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Purchases |

### Vendor manager

Role id: `vendor-manager`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Keep vendor relationships, renewals, SLAs and exit options under control. |
| Scope of responsibility | Vendor register, renewals, SLA tracking, data processing terms, offboarding vendors. |
| Core activities | Maintain register; Track renewals and SLAs; Review incidents; Plan exits |
| Inputs | Contracts; Usage; Incidents |
| Outputs and deliverables | Vendor register; Renewal calendar; Exit plans |
| Decisions it can make | Register content |
| Decisions requiring approval | Renewals and cancellations |
| Collaborating roles | finance; legal; engineering |
| Reporting relationship | operations-lead |
| KPIs | Renewals handled on time; Vendor incidents resolved |
| Quality expectations | Data export and deletion path known per vendor |
| Tools and resources | Vendor register template |
| Common failure modes | Auto-renew surprises; Lock-in discovered late |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Renewals |
